label: Definition
subgoals: Embed legs sin(theta), cos(theta) under hypotenuse 1
Square and add for sin^2(theta) + cos^2(theta) = 1
Solve sin(theta) = +/-sqrt(1 - cos^2(theta)) with quadrant signs

label: Domain restrictions
subgoals: Exclude odd pi/2 multiples for tan^2 + 1 = sec^2
Exclude multiples of pi for 1 + cot^2 = csc^2
Keep sin^2 + cos^2 = 1 valid on all R

label: Validity for arbitrary angles
subgoals: Redefine sin/cos as circle coordinates for any theta
Substitute into x^2 + y^2 = 1 for universal validity
